title: Cartesian comparison of two effective affine models
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a singleton fpqc covering of schemes [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering, def-pc-scheme] and let $D$ be a transport descent datum on $V\to X$ [def-pd-descent-datum]. For each affine open $A\subset S$ write $X_A=X\times_S A$ and $V_A=V\times_X X_A$, with their chosen projections [def-pc-fibre-product]. Suppose given a datum $E_A$ on $V_A\to X_A$ relative to $X_A\to A$, such that projection to $V$ intertwines its transport with $D$. Fix a scheme $W_A\to A$ and a morphism $r_A:V_A\to W_A$ whose square with $V_A\to X_A$ and $X_A\to A$ is Cartesian and whose composites with transported points of $E_A$ are invariant. For any affine inclusion $i:U\hookrightarrow B$, let $c_i:V_U\to V_B$ be the canonical restriction map (the transition of the affine cover of $S$ pulled back first to $X$ and then to $V$). There exists $t:W_U\to W_B$ such that the square with edges $t$, $W_U\to U$, $W_B\to B$ and $i$ is Cartesian and $c_i\,r_B=r_U\,t$. No global glued scheme or identity or composition laws for a family of transitions are asserted.

proof.text: Pull back the B-model W_B to U. Its canonical pullback to X_U identifies with V_U via the chosen Cartesian square for r_B and the iterated pullback identities. The U-model also pulls back to V_U via its specified square.

proof.text: The common identification is compatible with transport: both local transports project to the same D-transport on V by hcompat. The projection V_U -> V is a monomorphism, being a base change of an open immersion, so equality after projection identifies the transported points. On an effective Cartesian model, invariance of r and its universal property identify E with the canonical descent datum.

source.place: Tag 02W3, lemma-descending-types-morphisms, general-base proof, affine-open restriction and relative gluing

proof.text: The cover X_U -> U is fpqc by base change. Apply fpqc full faithfulness of morphisms to descend the common pullback identification between W_U and W_B times_B U, and descend its inverse. Faithfulness proves that their composites are identities. The descended isomorphism followed by the projection to W_B defines t.

source.place: Tag 02W3, lemma-descending-types-morphisms, general-base proof, affine-open restriction and relative gluing

proof.text: The isomorphism W_U to W_B times_B U gives the Cartesian square. Reconstruction in descent says that its pullback map is the chosen comparison on V_U, giving c_i followed by r_B equal to r_U followed by t. This argument covers empty opens and empty objects and does not require affine intersections.

theorem fpqc_affine_model_transition
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (hf : Presieve.singleton f ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage S)
    {V : Over X} (D : Over.DescentDatum f V)
    (E : ∀ U : S.affineOpens,
      Over.DescentDatum (pullback.snd f U.1.ι)
        (Over.mk (pullback.snd V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι))))
    (hcompat : ∀ U : S.affineOpens,
        ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (a b : T ⟶ pullback f U.1.ι)
          (hab : a ≫ pullback.snd f U.1.ι = b ≫ pullback.snd f U.1.ι)
          (x : Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk (pullback.snd V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι))),
          (D.transport (a ≫ pullback.fst f U.1.ι) (b ≫ pullback.fst f U.1.ι)
            (by simp only [Category.assoc, pullback.condition]; rw [← Category.assoc,
              ← Category.assoc, hab])
            (Over.homMk (x.left ≫ pullback.fst V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι))
              (by simpa [Category.assoc, pullback.condition] using
                  congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ pullback.fst f U.1.ι) (Over.w x)))).left =
            ((E U).transport a b hab x).left ≫ pullback.fst V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι))
    (W : ∀ U : S.affineOpens, Over U.1.toScheme)
    (r : ∀ U : S.affineOpens,
      pullback V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι) ⟶ (W U).left)
    (hp : ∀ U, IsPullback (r U) (pullback.snd V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι))
      (W U).hom (pullback.snd f U.1.ι))
    (hinv : ∀ (U : S.affineOpens) {T : Scheme.{u}}
      (a b : T ⟶ pullback f U.1.ι)
      (hab : a ≫ pullback.snd f U.1.ι = b ≫ pullback.snd f U.1.ι)
      (x : Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk (pullback.snd V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι))),
      ((E U).transport a b hab x).left ≫ r U = x.left ≫ r U)
    {U B : S.affineOpens} (i : U ⟶ B) :
    ∃ t : (W U).left ⟶ (W B).left,
      IsPullback t (W U).hom (W B).hom (S.directedAffineCover.trans i) ∧
      Scheme.Cover.trans ((S.directedAffineCover.pullback₁ f).pullback₁ V.hom) i ≫ r B =
        r U ≫ t
